cards.name: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflection of Kiki-Jiki

Sword of Truth and Justice.text: +2/+2, protection from white and blue; on a hit a +1/+1 counter and proliferate. The fourth Sword if one underperforms.

Sword of Sinew and Steel.text: +2/+2, protection from black and red; on a hit destroy a planeswalker and an artifact. Protection from red blanks most burn aimed at the body.

Sword of Hearth and Home.text: +2/+2, protection from green and white; on a hit blink a creature you own (resets the body's damage) and ramp a basic.

Maul of the Skyclaves.text: Attaches on entry: +2/+2, flying, first strike. Strong on any body; the Equipment slots went to the Swords.

Bladehold War-Whip.text: A 2/2 Rebel on entry; equip costs {1} less and equipped creatures have double strike. Cheaper equips for three Swords.

Kaldra Compleat.text: 7 mana: a 5/5 germ with indestructible, haste, first strike, trample; exiles what it hits. Top-end if the curve has room.

Lightning Bolt.text: 1-mana 3 damage; the first removal back if interaction is short.

Abrade.text: OWNED. 3 damage to a creature or destroy an artifact.

Chaos Warp.text: Shuffles any permanent away; a red answer to enchantments and planeswalkers.

Fateful Absence.text: 2-mana instant: destroy a creature or planeswalker; they get a Clue.

Collective Inferno.text: OWNED. Doubles the damage of sources of a chosen type you control: a double-damage Voltron body and doubled Self-Destruct.

Aurelia, Exemplar of Justice.text: The alternative commander: +2/+0, trample and vigilance on one creature every combat, and a flier. Pure Voltron, but no card flow.

Unleash Fury.text: Cut in the draft for Monastery Mentor: doubles power, overlapping Bulk Up.

Return the Favor.text: Cut in the draft for Fiery Confluence: a copy/redirect trick, weaker at 100 cards.

Sigarda's Aid.text: Cut in the draft for Tome of Legends: flash Equipment and auto-attach; low power on its own.

Speedball, New Warrior.text: ILLEGAL under Feather: the {W/U} hybrid puts blue in its colour identity. Boros Reckoner took the slot.

Sram, Senior Edificer.text: Draws on Equipment and Aura casts (about nine here); thin for a slot.

Clash of Titans.text: 5-mana fight Feather returns; The Last Agni Kai does it for 2.

Ephemerate.text: OWNED. Feather returns it, but the blink resets the body's counters and Equipment fall off.

Rabid Gnaw.text: OWNED. Your creature gets +1/+0, then deals damage equal to its power to a creature you don't control: a 2-mana bite Feather returns every end step, so removal every turn off the deck's one big body. PROPOSED for Lightning Greaves.

Giantfall.text: OWNED. Your creature deals damage equal to its power to their creature, or destroy an artifact. Feather returns the bite mode (it targets your creature); a second repeatable removal spell. PROPOSED for Energybending.

Fall of the Hammer.text: CRAFT (C). Your creature deals damage equal to its power to another creature: the third repeatable bite. PROPOSED for Choreographed Sparks.

Temur Battle Rage.text: CRAFT (C). Double strike, plus trample with a 4-power creature out (nearly always here). Feather returns it, so the body swings with double strike and trample every turn. PROPOSED for Pain for All.

Might of the Meek.text: OWNED. {R}: trample and draw a card; Feather makes it a 1-mana draw every turn. PROPOSED for Crackling Cyclops.

Rogue's Passage.text: OWNED. A land: {4},{T}: target creature can't be blocked. The Voltron finisher that costs no spell slot. PROPOSED for a Mountain.

Laelia, the Blade Reforged.text: OWNED. Haste; each attack exiles the top card to play this turn, and she grows whenever cards are exiled from your library or graveyard. A body that draws and gets bigger; strong carrier for the Swords. PROPOSED for Mabel, Heir to Cragflame.

Akiri, Fearless Voyager.text: CRAFT (R). Draw a card whenever you attack with an equipped creature; {W}: move an Equipment to make a creature indestructible. Card flow from the Equipment package. PROPOSED for Ferocification.

Tenth District Legionnaire.text: CRAFT (U). A 2-mana haste body that gets a +1/+1 counter and scry 1 for every spell that targets it; Feather's tricks hit it every turn. SPICE: the body you build up. PROPOSED for Speed, Young Avenger.

Showdown of the Skalds.text: CRAFT (R). Saga: exile the top four and play them until chapter III; chapters II and III put a +1/+1 counter on a creature whenever you cast a spell. Card advantage the deck lacks. PROPOSED for Demonic Ruckus.

Blazing Crescendo.text: OWNED. +3/+1 and exile the top card to play through next turn; returned by Feather, an impulse draw every turn.

Ancestors' Aid.text: OWNED. +2/+0 and first strike plus a Treasure; returned by Feather, a Treasure every turn (ramp into Embercleave and Chandra's Ignition).

Dual-Sun Technique.text: OWNED. Double strike, and a card if the creature has a +1/+1 counter (Tenth District Legionnaire, Laelia, Showdown counters).

Panther Pounce.text: OWNED. {W}: +1/+0, flying, untap, and you investigate. A 1-mana Clue every turn with Feather.

Reyav, Master Smith.text: CRAFT (U). Equipped or enchanted attackers gain double strike: every Sword trigger twice. Overlaps the double-strike tricks.

Bruenor Battlehammer.text: CRAFT (U). +2/+0 per Equipment on each creature and the first equip each turn is free: moves three Swords around without mana.

Zada, Hedron Grinder.text: CRAFT (R). SPICE: a spell that targets only Zada is copied for each other creature you control; with Monastery Mentor Monks and Heroic Reinforcements tokens, one Feather-returned pump hits the whole team.

Champion of the Flame.text: CRAFT (U). SPICE: trample, +2/+2 per Aura and Equipment attached. A cheap body that gets enormous under two Swords.

Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflectio.text: CRAFT (R). A Goblin that makes Treasure, a rummage chapter, then a copy machine (copy Laelia or Tenth District Legionnaire). Value, but not a Feather card.

Castle Embereth.text: CRAFT (R). A Mountain-gated untapped land that pumps the team +1/+0. Replaces a basic at no spell cost.

Castle Ardenvale.text: CRAFT (R). A Plains-gated land that makes 1/1s late. Replaces a basic.

Eiganjo, Seat of the Empire.text: CRAFT (R). A Plains that can channel for 4 damage to an attacker or blocker. Replaces a basic.

Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance.text: CRAFT (R). A Mountain that can channel for two hasty 1/1s. Replaces a basic.

Spectacular Tactics.text: OWNED. A +1/+1 counter and hexproof (Feather returns that mode), or destroy a creature with power 4+ (that mode targets theirs, so it is not returned).

Feat of Resistance.text: CRAFT (C). A +1/+1 counter and protection from a colour; returned each turn.

Kaya's Onslaught.text: CRAFT (U). +1/+1 and double strike; foretell for {W}. Overlaps Temur Battle Rage.

Two-Handed Axe.text: OWNED. SPICE: the Adventure half is a double-strike instant that targets your creature, so Feather can return it to hand instead of sending it on an adventure; or cast the Equipment that doubles power on attack.

Swift Kick.text: CRAFT (C). A 4-mana fight Feather returns; Rabid Gnaw, Giantfall and Fall of the Hammer do it for 2.

Brimaz, King of Oreskos.text: OWNED. A strong 3-drop, but its tokens come from attacking and blocking, not from the deck's tricks.

Phalanx Leader.text: CRAFT (U). Heroic: a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control per targeting spell; the deck is not wide enough to pay it off.

Integrity // Intervention.text: CRAFT (U). Integrity (+2/+2 for one hybrid mana) returns with Feather; Intervention is 3 damage and 3 life. Fine, unexceptional.
